psychological_meaning: Amethyst is associated with spirituality, intuition, and transformation. It fosters a sense of calm and peace, promoting mental clarity and higher consciousness. This color often represents wisdom, dignity, and creativity, encouraging introspection and spiritual growth. It can also symbolize luxury and sophistication due to its historical association with royalty.
